newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rail strike in south France halts traffic to Spain.
newsitem.headline: Rail strike in south France halts traffic to Spain.

text.p: A rail strike, which has been disrupting traffic for several days in parts of southern France, brought to a standstill services to northeast Spain on Wednesday and looked set to spread, trade union officials said.
Rail workers are protesting against job cuts planned in a reorganisation of the loss-making state railway company SNCF and are demanding that new staff be hired to restore the quality of service.

The strike in the southern cities of Narbonne, Perpignan, Beziers and Nimes halted services to and from the Spanish city of Barcelona and between France's Atlantic and Mediterranean coasts, SNCF said.
Nearly 90 percent of traffic on major routes in the region, at the eastern end of the Pyrenees, was brought to a standstill and almost all local traffic came to a halt.
Union officials said rail workers in the region were holding meetings and that the strike could later spread further eastwards to the city of Montpellier.
